image_description: A top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a surface. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in a linear series. These plates are greyish-green with vertical striations and are surrounded by a dark brown, textured leathery girdle (mantle).
